main_text.l: ANalyticam Expositionem E-
pistolarum Apostolicarum
a Cl: viro Domino Davide
Dicsono concinnatam, le-
gi avidus; guftatâ antea sua-
vissimâ necnon ut ilissimâ ejus commentati-
one Anglico jdiomate, in Epistolam ad
Hebræos, conscriptâ; De utrâq; dicam
quod sentio, jmo quod res est, Satis mul-
tum in jis reperturum, qui non expectat ni-
mis. Nec quicquam me vidisse in tanta bre-
vitate, tantum porrigens, et sensus genuini
sacri textus et fructus jnde colligendi. Gra-
tulor itaq; Jnsulanis nostris præsertim stu-
diosæ juventuti, tam egregia Doctrinæ, quæ
est secundum pietatem, adminicula. Mul-
tum a R. Authore efflagitans, tam ut utram-
que curet (quod de postremâ hâc videtur
promittere) & doctis & Jdiotis communi-
carj; quam ut denuò se accingat ad enar-
randas

page.notes: The initial "A" is a large woodcut initial; it is transcribed as "A" joined to "Nalyticam" with the first letter read as A. Printing irregularities (e.g. "Dicsono", "jdiomate", "ilissimâ") are left as printed. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page with "enarrandas", a catchword-like line set right-aligned, which is treated as the last line of the text.
